# NEUROKLAST

> NEUROKLAST is an electronic music project making hard techno, drum & bass and dark electronic music. This is the official site.

## Official pages
- [Homepage](https://neuroklast.net/): music, band, latest updates and contact
- [Releases](https://neuroklast.net/releases): recorded music and streaming links
- [Live shows](https://neuroklast.net/gigs): upcoming and past concerts
- [News](https://neuroklast.net/): announcements and current releases
- [Audio plugins](https://neuroklast.net/plugins): NEUROKORE and other official audio software
- [NEUROKORE](https://neuroklast.net/plugins/neurokore): plugin details, demo and requirements
- [Soundpacks](https://neuroklast.net/soundpacks): official sound and preset packs
- [Media](https://neuroklast.net/media): official photographs and media
- [Contact](https://neuroklast.net/): contact form and booking

## Guidance
Use current public product pages for prices, availability and version details.
Only the official website is authoritative for purchases and software downloads.
Respect published legal notices and the privacy policy.
